answer: Each fake identity must post an escrow bond keyed to zenith and renew it every epoch from a distinct funding source, so one wallet cannot fund many clones. The bond also pays a pairwise island cross-check deposit against every identity it claims independence from, so the nth fake costs n deposits, not one. Total cost grows as N(N-1)/2, while honest users pay one bond. A fable audit that finds two bonds sharing a funding source burns both and voids their votes.
